name: Himegimi no Toaru Ichinichi
source:
Before her birthday, princess Margot wrote a letter to her uncle, Benedict.
As he is one of her few remaining relatives, she only wanted to reconciliate with him, but...

因为他是她仅存的几个亲人之一，她只想与他和解，但是……
